title: Performance Marketing
intro: Connect campaign decisions to clear goals, useful measurement and the people you want to reach.
audience: For marketing teams who want a more deliberate approach to paid activity, campaign creative and learning from available performance data.
audiencePoints: Businesses planning a campaign around a specific objective
Teams aligning creative and paid-media activity
Brands reviewing how current campaigns are measured
deliverables: Align audience, offer, channel and campaign objective before activation.
Shape campaign messaging and variants around the agreed audience and placement.
Prepare campaign structures and launch support for approved platforms and budgets.
Summarise available campaign data and identify questions for the next cycle.
process: Agree the business goal, audience and available measurement.
Choose the message, creative needs and channel approach.
Prepare approved assets, settings and tracking for launch.
Review the data available and agree the next useful adjustment.
faqs: Which channels can be part of a campaign?
The channel mix depends on the audience, objective, creative and account access agreed for the project.
No fixed outcome is promised. Performance depends on the offer, market, budget, audience, platform and other factors.
Can you work with an existing marketing team?
Yes. The scope can focus on campaign planning, creative coordination or a defined part of the current workflow.
